records.text: Chief Apothecary Hildagard works in Shadowmoon Village, investigating its haunting. She warns that seeing the valley’s ghosts can change a person, crafts Spectrecles to reveal them, and asks for help clearing spirits from the village. Gorefiend’s story startles her; she recounts how Gul'dan placed the slain warlock’s soul in a knight of Stormwind, creating the first death knight of the Horde.
